# Project-owned shared goal editor. Template inputs contain validated IDs only.
# Heavy bodies cross hidden-event boundaries; no technology x slot windows.
ttegs_capture = { country_event = { id = ttegoal.11 } }
ttegs_request = { country_event = { id = ttegoal.10 } }
ttegs_commit = { country_event = { id = ttegoal.12 } }
ttegs_cancel = { country_event = { id = ttegoal.13 } }

country_event = {
 id = ttegoal.13 hide_window = yes is_triggered_only = yes
 immediate = {
  remove_country_flag=ttegs_pending_alpha
remove_country_flag=ttegs_pending_arbitrary_mod_new
remove_country_flag=ttegs_pending_repeatable
  remove_country_flag = ttegs_dialog
  remove_country_flag = ttegs_pending_valid
  remove_country_flag = ttegs_occupied
  clear_variable = ttegs_destination
  clear_variable = ttegs_origin
  clear_variable = ttegs_count
 }
}
country_event = {
 id = ttegoal.11 hide_window = yes is_triggered_only = yes
 immediate = {
  ttegs_cancel = yes
  set_variable = { which = ttegs_count value = 0 }
  set_variable = { which = ttegs_origin value = 0 }
  if={limit={has_country_flag=tte_viewed_alpha} set_country_flag=ttegs_pending_alpha change_variable={which=ttegs_count value=1} if={limit={has_country_flag=ttegs_pending_alpha has_country_flag=tte_goal_alpha} set_variable={which=ttegs_origin value=tte_rank_alpha}}}
if={limit={has_country_flag=tte_viewed_arbitrary_mod_new} set_country_flag=ttegs_pending_arbitrary_mod_new change_variable={which=ttegs_count value=1} if={limit={has_country_flag=ttegs_pending_arbitrary_mod_new has_country_flag=tte_goal_arbitrary_mod_new} set_variable={which=ttegs_origin value=tte_rank_arbitrary_mod_new}}}
if={limit={has_country_flag=tte_viewed_repeatable} set_country_flag=ttegs_pending_repeatable change_variable={which=ttegs_count value=1} if={limit={has_country_flag=ttegs_pending_repeatable has_country_flag=tte_goal_repeatable} set_variable={which=ttegs_origin value=tte_rank_repeatable}}}
 }
}
country_event = {
 id = ttegoal.10 hide_window = yes is_triggered_only = yes
 immediate = {
  ttegs_recheck = yes
  if = {
   limit = { check_variable = { which = ttegs_count value = 1 } check_variable = { which = ttegs_destination value >= 1 } check_variable = { which = ttegs_destination value <= 5 } has_country_flag = ttegs_pending_valid }
   if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = ttegs_origin value = ttegs_destination } } ttegs_cancel = yes }
   else = {
    if={limit={check_variable={which=ttegs_destination value=1} has_country_flag=tte_slot_1} set_country_flag=ttegs_occupied}
if={limit={check_variable={which=ttegs_destination value=2} has_country_flag=tte_slot_2} set_country_flag=ttegs_occupied}
if={limit={check_variable={which=ttegs_destination value=3} has_country_flag=tte_slot_3} set_country_flag=ttegs_occupied}
if={limit={check_variable={which=ttegs_destination value=4} has_country_flag=tte_slot_4} set_country_flag=ttegs_occupied}
if={limit={check_variable={which=ttegs_destination value=5} has_country_flag=tte_slot_5} set_country_flag=ttegs_occupied}
    if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ttegs_occupied }
     set_country_flag = ttegs_dialog
     country_event = { id = ttegoal.1 }
    }
    else = { ttegs_commit = yes }
   }
  }
  else = { ttegs_cancel = yes }
 }
}
country_event = {
 id = ttegoal.12 hide_window = yes is_triggered_only = yes
 immediate = {
  # Recheck the frozen technology, not a node clicked behind the confirmation.
  ttegs_recheck = yes
  if = {
   limit = { check_variable = { which = ttegs_count value = 1 } check_variable = { which = ttegs_destination value >= 1 } check_variable = { which = ttegs_destination value <= 5 } has_country_flag = ttegs_pending_valid }
   set_variable = { which = ttegs_origin value = 0 }
   country_event = { id = ttegoal.15 }
   # Change all ranks atomically before invoking the research refresh once.
   country_event = { id = ttegoal.16 }
   country_event = { id = ttegoal.17 }
   if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = tte_has_goal } } set_country_flag = tte_automation }
   set_country_flag = tte_has_goal
   tte_refresh = yes
  }
  ttegs_cancel = yes
 }
}
country_event = {
 id = ttegoal.15 hide_window = yes is_triggered_only = yes
 immediate = { if={limit={has_country_flag=ttegs_pending_alpha has_country_flag=tte_goal_alpha} set_variable={which=ttegs_origin value=tte_rank_alpha}}
if={limit={has_country_flag=ttegs_pending_arbitrary_mod_new has_country_flag=tte_goal_arbitrary_mod_new} set_variable={which=ttegs_origin value=tte_rank_arbitrary_mod_new}}
if={limit={has_country_flag=ttegs_pending_repeatable has_country_flag=tte_goal_repeatable} set_variable={which=ttegs_origin value=tte_rank_repeatable}} }
}
country_event = {
 id = ttegoal.16 hide_window = yes is_triggered_only = yes
 immediate = { if={limit={has_country_flag=tte_goal_alpha NOT={has_country_flag=ttegs_pending_alpha} check_variable={which=tte_rank_alpha value=ttegs_destination}} if={limit={check_variable={which=ttegs_origin value>0}} set_variable={which=tte_rank_alpha value=ttegs_origin}} else={remove_country_flag=tte_goal_alpha clear_variable=tte_rank_alpha}}
if={limit={has_country_flag=tte_goal_arbitrary_mod_new NOT={has_country_flag=ttegs_pending_arbitrary_mod_new} check_variable={which=tte_rank_arbitrary_mod_new value=ttegs_destination}} if={limit={check_variable={which=ttegs_origin value>0}} set_variable={which=tte_rank_arbitrary_mod_new value=ttegs_origin}} else={remove_country_flag=tte_goal_arbitrary_mod_new clear_variable=tte_rank_arbitrary_mod_new}}
if={limit={has_country_flag=tte_goal_repeatable NOT={has_country_flag=ttegs_pending_repeatable} check_variable={which=tte_rank_repeatable value=ttegs_destination}} if={limit={check_variable={which=ttegs_origin value>0}} set_variable={which=tte_rank_repeatable value=ttegs_origin}} else={remove_country_flag=tte_goal_repeatable clear_variable=tte_rank_repeatable}} }
}
country_event = {
 id = ttegoal.17 hide_window = yes is_triggered_only = yes
 immediate = { if={limit={has_country_flag=ttegs_pending_alpha} set_country_flag=tte_goal_alpha set_variable={which=tte_rank_alpha value=ttegs_destination}}
if={limit={has_country_flag=ttegs_pending_arbitrary_mod_new} set_country_flag=tte_goal_arbitrary_mod_new set_variable={which=tte_rank_arbitrary_mod_new value=ttegs_destination}}
if={limit={has_country_flag=ttegs_pending_repeatable} set_country_flag=tte_goal_repeatable set_variable={which=tte_rank_repeatable value=ttegs_destination}} }
}
